title: 醫療與長照機構感染管制查核申訴與諮詢
summary: 機構對感染管制查核結果有異議可於收受通知後 30 日內申請複核；民眾發現機構感染管制疏失可向衛生局或疾管署陳情，處理期間約 30 日。
introMarkdown:
感染管制查核由地方衛生局會同疾管署辦理。

- **機構申請複核**：對查核結果有異議者，請於收受結果通知之日起 **30 日內**檢具理由與佐證申請複核。
- **民眾陳情**：對醫院或長照機構感染管制（例如未落實手部衛生、群聚未通報）有疑慮，可向轄區衛生局陳情，或透過署長信箱反映。

本服務不處理醫療糾紛與個別醫療行為爭議，請洽衛生局醫政單位。
requiredDocuments: 機構複核：申請書、查核結果通知、佐證資料
民眾陳情：機構名稱、發生時間、具體事實（可匿名，但無法回覆）

steps.title: 提出申請或陳情
steps.text: 機構以公文、民眾以信箱或電話提出。

steps.title: 分案
steps.text: 依機構所在地分送衛生局與區管中心。
steps.who: 感染管制及生物安全組

steps.title: 調查或複核
steps.text: 書面審查，必要時實地訪查。

steps.title: 回覆結果
steps.who: 感染管制及生物安全組

legalBasis: 傳染病防治法第 32 條
醫療機構執行感染控制措施及查核辦法

faq.q: 陳情會不會讓機構知道是我？
faq.a: 陳情人身分依法保密，調查時不會揭露。

faq.q: 複核期間需要先改善嗎？
faq.a: 涉及病人安全之缺失仍須先行改善，複核結果另行通知。

en.title: Infection control audit appeals and enquiries for medical and long-term care facilities
en.summary: A facility that disagrees with an infection control audit result may apply for a review within 30 days of receiving the notice; members of the public who notice infection control lapses at a facility may petition the local health bureau or Taiwan CDC. Handling takes about 30 days.
en.introMarkdown:
Infection control audits are carried out by local health bureaus together with Taiwan CDC.

- **Facility applying for a review**: if you disagree with the audit result, submit your reasons and supporting evidence **within 30 days** of receiving the notice.
- **Public petition**: if you have concerns about infection control at a hospital or long-term care facility (for example hand hygiene not being followed, or a cluster not reported), petition the local health bureau or write to the Director-General's mailbox.

This service does not handle medical disputes or complaints about individual clinical decisions; please contact the medical affairs unit of the local health bureau.
requiredDocuments: Facility review request: application form, audit result notice, supporting documents
Public petition: name of the facility, time of the incident, concrete facts (anonymous petitions are accepted, but cannot be answered)

steps.title: Submit the request or petition
steps.text: Facilities submit an official letter; members of the public use the mailbox or telephone.

steps.title: Assign the case
steps.text: The case is sent to the health bureau and regional centre where the facility is located.
steps.who: Division of Infection Control and Biosafety

steps.title: Investigation or review
steps.text: Document review, with an on-site visit if necessary.

steps.title: Reply with the result
steps.text: A written reply is sent to the applicant.
steps.who: Division of Infection Control and Biosafety

en.contact: Taiwan CDC Division of Infection Control and Biosafety (switchboard +886-2-2395-9825); for general enquiries call the 1922 hotline (from abroad +886-800-001922).
legalBasis: Regulations on Infection Control Measures and Audits for Medical Institutions

forms.label: Application form for review of infection control audit results
forms.href: /pending/?ref=service.infection-control-audit-complaint&doc=感染管制查核結果複核申請書

faq.q: Will the facility know it was me who petitioned?
faq.a: The identity of the petitioner is protected by law and is not disclosed during the investigation.

faq.q: Do we need to make improvements while the review is under way?
faq.a: Deficiencies that affect patient safety must still be corrected first; the review result will be notified separately.

tl.title: Apela at konsultasyon sa pagsusuri ng pagkontrol sa impeksyon para sa mga pasilidad medikal at pangmatagalang pangangalaga
tl.summary: Maaaring humiling ng muling pagsusuri ang pasilidad sa loob ng 30 araw mula sa pagtanggap ng abiso; maaaring magsumite ng petisyon sa lokal na kawanihan ng kalusugan o sa Taiwan CDC ang publiko. Mga 30 araw ang pagproseso.

vi.title: Khiếu nại và tư vấn về kết quả kiểm tra kiểm soát nhiễm khuẩn đối với cơ sở y tế và chăm sóc dài hạn
vi.summary: Cơ sở không đồng ý với kết quả kiểm tra có thể xin xem xét lại trong vòng 30 ngày kể từ khi nhận thông báo; người dân phát hiện sai sót về kiểm soát nhiễm khuẩn có thể kiến nghị với cục y tế địa phương hoặc Taiwan CDC. Thời gian xử lý khoảng 30 ngày.

id.title: Banding dan konsultasi hasil audit pengendalian infeksi untuk fasilitas medis dan perawatan jangka panjang
id.summary: Fasilitas yang keberatan dengan hasil audit dapat mengajukan peninjauan ulang dalam 30 hari sejak menerima pemberitahuan; masyarakat yang menemukan kelalaian pengendalian infeksi dapat mengadu ke dinas kesehatan setempat atau Taiwan CDC. Pemrosesan sekitar 30 hari.

th.title: การอุทธรณ์และขอคำปรึกษาผลการตรวจประเมินการควบคุมการติดเชื้อของสถานพยาบาลและสถานดูแลระยะยาว
th.summary: สถานพยาบาลที่ไม่เห็นด้วยกับผลการตรวจสามารถขอให้ทบทวนได้ภายใน 30 วันนับจากได้รับแจ้ง ประชาชนที่พบข้อบกพร่องด้านการควบคุมการติดเชื้อสามารถร้องเรียนต่อสำนักงานสาธารณสุขท้องถิ่นหรือ Taiwan CDC ใช้เวลาดำเนินการประมาณ 30 วัน
